_comment: Pass B - company marks for organisations whose name begins M-Z or with a digit. Actor test applied per docs/origins-figure-system.md section 7: a mark ships only where the organisation is an actor in the history, never beside a technology that merely shares its name. Every licence was read off the file's own Commons description page via the API's extmetadata plus the page wikitext, never off an article. No non-free or fair-use file was downloaded. All marks are reproduced unaltered beyond sanitising, are not used as this product's branding, favicon or OG image, and name their owner in the credit: nominative use. No organisation in this corpus begins with a digit. Written 2026-08-22.

Weibo Corporation (Sina Weibo).reason: actor - the platform that went inaccessible for two hours on 8 October 2017. Commons hosts no free Weibo corporate mark; the only hit is a third-party icon-set redrawing, and redrawing a mark is forbidden. Set the name in the book's type.

Ulster Bank.reason: actor - one of the two banks whose overnight batch failed in June 2012. Commons has photographs of branches but no logo file. Set the name in the book's type.

Move Networks, Inc..reason: actor - shipped adaptive bitrate streaming as static streamlets; the whole of the p3c21 cold open. No file on Commons under any title. Set the name in the book's type.

Media Rating Council, Inc..reason: actor - published the understatement gap and voted to suspend Nielsen's accreditation. No file on Commons. Set the name in the book's type.
